summary: Massive drone offensive targets Moscow with 1,600+ UAVs striking Gazpromneft-MNPF refinery in Kapotnya and logistics park Sofyino, while Russian forces expand ground operations in Kharkiv region. Ukraine's steel industry effectively paralyzed after ballistic missile strikes on blast furnaces. Ukrainian casualties reach 27,000 per month per Polish PM Tusk citing new Russian jet-powered drone strategy.
key_points: Moscow hit by 1,600+ drones; Gazpromneft-MNPF refinery in Kapotnya struck, logistics park Sofyino (850,000 m²) burning (Source: UkraineNow/84195).
Polish PM Tusk: Ukrainian casualties ~27,000/month, Russian jet-powered drone strategy, winter could be catastrophic (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/33371).
90% Ukraine steel industry idle after ballistic missiles hit blast furnaces in Zaporizhzhia/Dnipropetrovsk regions (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/33382).
Russian forces expanding control in Kharkiv region: Petropavlovka, Polnaya, Novoaleksandrovka, Prikolnoye (Source: tass_agency/396336).
Stari Petrivtsi, Kyiv region: 15-year-old Ivan Danchenko killed, school and infrastructure damaged (Source: eRadarrua/114651).
Dnipro shopping center struck, fire, casualties unknown (Source: UkraineNow/84190).
Odesa TCC employee sentenced 7 years for torture, abduction, sexual violence threats (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/33373).
Reactive Shahed drones launched from Mykolaiv, Bryansk, and Odesa regions toward multiple Ukrainian oblasts (Source: mon1tor_ua/75273).

sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting mass UAV campaigns against Moscow (1,600+ drones) while simultaneously expanding ground operations in Kharkiv region toward Petropavlovka, Polnaya, Novoaleksandrovka, and Prikolnoye. The use of jet-powered drones and ballistic missiles against steel infrastructure indicates a strategy targeting Ukraine's economic backbone. Ukrainian interceptor drones and long-range UAV strikes on Russian refinery infrastructure (Kapotnya) suggest reciprocal escalation. Winter conditions may compound humanitarian impact given 27,000 monthly Ukrainian casualties reported by Tusk.
sections.regional_response: Poland's PM Tusk highlighted catastrophic winter risks for Ukraine citing record casualty figures. Election infrastructure in Russia attacked: Kherson bus killing 2 including election commissioner, Zaporizhzhia station destroyed. Moscow mayor declared largest drone attack. US signed sanctions law against Russia initiated by late Senator Graham. Ukrainian Dip Strikes unit requesting power banks/generators for autonomous long-range UAV operations.
sections.intelligence_notes: Alabuga underground Shahed production workshops ~42,000 m² built. Fire Point warehouse (UAV components/launch boosters) hit in Kyiv region. Mykolaiv-based reactive UAV groups active toward Kirovohrad and Dnipropetrovsk. Bryansk-origin Shahed heading Chernihiv. Multiple reactive UAV trajectories from Odesa, Mykolaiv, and Cherkasy regions indicating coordinated aerial campaign. Tengiz/Kashagan oil context is not war-related and omitted.
